about: Visitor eval for the website chatbot, stage 1 (plan 8.1). 30 Citrix-LP questions: 10 cost/renewal, 6 migration/risk, 6 compatibility, 4 security/compliance, 4 general; 17 are not in the bank (paraphrases or new; in_bank false); 3 are traps. Run: node web/scripts/web-eval.mjs <base> (live, x-sam-eval) or --dry (in-process, network stubbed). `accept`: what counts as a correct answer, judged on the FIRST block that identifies a record: a qa id, `url:<prefix>` for a page fact or page card, `@fallback` / `@guard` for an honest non-answer. A later block in `accept` scores 'partly'. `forbid`: regexes (case-insensitive) that must not appear anywhere in the answer; a hit counts as an invented claim. Written without looking at what the pipeline returns.

cases.q: How much does Accops cost compared with Citrix?
Our Citrix renewal quote just went up a lot. What can we do?
What licensing models are available?
Can we buy perpetual licences instead of a subscription?
How do we know Accops won't raise prices at renewal too?
What savings have customers reported?
Is Accops cheaper than Citrix for 500 users?
Do you license by concurrent users or named users?
What's the TCO saving if we switch?
cases.note: The LP's TCO rates and headline tiles are blocked; only figures published in a case study may show.

cases.q: Which Citrix components would we stop paying for?
Can we migrate off Citrix without downtime?
How long does a Citrix to Accops migration take?
Can we do a proof of concept before we commit?
Will our users have to learn a new tool?
Do we have to replace our hypervisor, Active Directory or file servers?
What if something goes wrong halfway through the move off Citrix?
Does Accops run on Nutanix AHV?
Can we keep our VMware vSphere hosts?
Is Microsoft Hyper-V supported?
Does Accops work with Azure Virtual Desktop?
Will our existing thin clients work with Accops?
cases.note: No bank pair covers thin clients: the honest answer is the fallback, or a public accops.com fact about endpoints.

cases.q: Does Accops support Proxmox?
Is Accops ISO 27001 certified?
Are you SOC 2 Type II certified?
cases.note: Only ISO 27001:2022 is held; no answer may claim SOC 2.

cases.q: Can Accops replace NetScaler / Citrix Gateway for remote access?
Do you help banks with RBI and CERT-In compliance?
Is Accops a real alternative to Citrix?
Who owns Accops?
Do you have customers in the Middle East?
Are you a Gartner leader?
cases.note: Gartner wording awaits legal; it is a blocked pattern.
